bookmarklet.title: Install Bookmarklet
bookmarklet.description: Save job postings with one click directly to your JobPilot Tracker — from any website.
bookmarklet.instructions: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar:
bookmarklet.dragHint: Tip: Simply drag and drop the button into your bookmarks list.
bookmarklet.step1Hint: If not visible yet: Ctrl+Shift+B (Windows) or Cmd+Shift+B (Mac).
bookmarklet.step2Hint: Drag the "Mark Job" button below via Drag & Drop to your bookmarks bar.
bookmarklet.step3Hint: Open a posting on LinkedIn, Indeed, Stepstone etc. and click "Mark Job" — a window opens with pre-filled data.
bookmarklet.autoCompanyHint: The company is automatically detected from these sites:
bookmarklet.howItWorksHint: A bookmarklet is a bookmark with JavaScript code instead of a URL. When clicked, it opens a small JobPilot window with pre-filled data — you verify it quickly, add notes, and click Save. No plugin, no store, works in every browser.
